'''Icarus'''<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-first-trailer-poster-art|text=Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord Teaser Trailer and First Poster Arrive}}</ref> was a [[male]] [[Zabrak]]<ref name="Trailer sw.com" /> who was an associate of the Zabrak criminal leader [[Maul]] during the early [[Imperial Era]]. At one point, Icarus and four other individuals were climbing down a [[skyscraper]] on the [[planet]] [[Janix]]. At some other point, Icarus, Maul, and<ref name="Teaser" /> Icarus' brother [[Scorn]]<ref name="Trailer sw.com" /> were fighting in a hallway with Icarus using a rotary [[blaster cannon]]. Icarus had light-red skin, red [[eye]]s and light-colored horns and, similarly to Maul and Scron, their face and body wcovered with dark [[tattoo]]s, including the entirety of their [[ear]]s. They wore black clothing with bare arms and the lower half of their face was hidden behind a black cowl.<ref name="Teaser" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Icarus is set to appear in the upcoming [[2026]] [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]'' where they will be voiced by [[Steve Blum]].<ref name="Announcement" /> The character was first pictured in a teaser trailer released on [[January 22]], 2026,<ref name="Teaser" /> and identified as Icarus in an accompanying article on [[StarWars.com]], although no information connected the two<ref name="Announcement" /> until the reveal of a [[Funko|Funko Pop!]] figurine of the character<ref name=Funko Pop!">{{Amazon|url=POP-Star-Wars-DMSR/dp/B08HH2ZT3D|text=Funko Pop! Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord - Darth Maul - Collectable Vinyl Figure - Gift Idea - Official Merchandise - Toys for Kids & Adults - Star Wars Fans - Model Figure for Collectors and Display}}</ref> on [[February 2]].<ref name="DisTrackers">{{Twitter|username=DisTrackers|name=DisTrackers|url=status/2018359297831501908|date=2026-02-02|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/r4Fr7}}</ref>

[[Wikipedia:Icarus|Icarus]] is a mythical character originating from [[Wikipedia:Greek mythology|Greek mythology]] known for flying too close to the Sun.<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/Icarus-Greek-mythology|text=Icarus | Greek mythology|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20150908005922}}</ref>
